title: AI output contract
description: The JSON object ANY AI model must return for one digest. Produced by the AI step (Make step 8), parsed in step 9, mapped into news_digests in step 10. Swapping the AI provider is safe as long as its output validates against this schema.

tone.description: Overall tone of the headlines for this asset. Lowercase.

summary.description: 2-3 sentence briefing, max ~60 words. No investment advice.

key_points.description: 3-5 short bullet points, most important first.

examples.summary: Coverage of NVIDIA is upbeat, led by reports of strong data-center demand and new cloud partnerships. Analysts flag supply constraints as the main near-term risk.

Several outlets report new cloud partnerships
Analysts cite chip supply limits as the key near-term risk
